name: Local models, VPN and several agents
beschreibung: Run a model on your own computer instead of in the cloud, connect Agent PCs via VPN and let several agents work together on a task.
zielgruppe: People with experience in networking and the terminal
voraussetzungen: Computer with at least 16 GB RAM (better 32 GB) or a graphics card for local models
kosten: none – local model or free model
lernziele: name the pros and cons of local models
enter a local model with an OpenAI-compatible interface in Hermes
make Agent PCs reachable via the VPN or the Bony Network
let two agents with separate roles work on one task
assess privacy and resources with local models

lektionen.ziel: Know when a local model fits.
Hermes answers with a local model.
Two Agent PCs reach each other.
Two agents complete a task together.
